_comment: Curated map of this repository's components, used by the agentic SDLC orchestrator for impact analysis (keyword matching in DETERMINISTIC_DEMO mode; grounding context sent to the model in LLM mode) and by the quality gate to reject unknown component names. ComponentCatalogTest fails the build if any path or test file listed here stops existing. Layers: DATA, SERVICE, CROSS_CUTTING, API, SECURITY, CONFIG (also the dependency order the demo planner uses).

components.name: UrlMapping
components.responsibility: JPA entity for a short link: shortCode, originalUrl, tenantId, expiry, click count, active flag (soft delete).

components.name: UrlMappingRepository
components.responsibility: Spring Data repository; every management query is tenant-scoped by (shortCode, tenantId); atomic click-count UPDATE.

components.name: Tenant
components.responsibility: Tenant entity: name, plan, hashed API key, active flag, custom domain.

components.name: UrlShortenerServiceImpl
components.responsibility: Core business rules: create (custom alias / generated code), update, deactivate, reactivate, resolve-and-record-hit.

components.name: RandomBase62ShortCodeGenerator
components.responsibility: Generates random, non-enumerable Base62 short codes with bounded collision retry.

components.name: CachedShortCodeLookup
components.responsibility: Caffeine-cached short-code resolution on the redirect hot path, with eviction on change.

components.name: ExpiredUrlCleanupService
components.responsibility: Scheduled batch deactivation of expired links.

components.name: FeignUrlSafetyChecker
components.responsibility: Feature-flagged external URL-reputation check (OpenFeign); fails open on error.

components.name: TenantService
components.responsibility: Tenant registration, API-key authentication and rotation, plan and status changes.

components.name: AdminService
components.responsibility: Cross-tenant operator views and mutations, composed over the tenant/url/usage aggregates.

components.name: TenantRateLimiterService
components.responsibility: Per-tenant fair-share token buckets (api and redirect families), local or Redis backend.

components.name: UsageMeteringService
components.responsibility: Async per-tenant, per-month counting of billable events (create + redirect).

components.name: BillingService
components.responsibility: Rates usage into a statement: base fee + included quota + overage, integer cents.

components.name: InvoiceService
components.responsibility: Freezes a statement into an immutable invoice, one per (tenant, period).

components.name: InvoicePdfGenerator
components.responsibility: Renders an issued invoice as a PDF (OpenPDF).

components.name: SdlcOrchestrator
components.responsibility: Runs the agentic SDLC pipeline that turns a requirement into reviewable artifacts.

components.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
components.responsibility: Single place every error becomes the shared JSON error envelope; never leaks internals.

components.name: RedirectController
components.responsibility: Public, unauthenticated GET /{shortCode} redirect (302) hot path.

components.name: UrlShortenerController
components.responsibility: Tenant-authenticated /api/v1/urls management API: create, list, stats, update, reactivate, deactivate.

components.name: UrlDtos
components.responsibility: Request/response records with Bean Validation (ShortenUrlRequest, UpdateUrlRequest, UrlStatsResponse, ...).

components.name: AdminController
components.responsibility: Operator-only /api/v1/admin/** endpoints (X-Admin-Key).

components.name: SecurityConfig
components.responsibility: Stateless filter chain; explicit per-route rules ending in denyAll().

components.name: ApiKeyAuthenticationFilter
components.responsibility: Resolves X-API-Key to a TenantPrincipal; rejects a presented-but-invalid key with 401.

components.name: RateLimitFilter
components.responsibility: Consumes one api token per authenticated tenant request; 429 with Retry-After when exhausted.

components.name: ApplicationProperties
components.responsibility: Common config plus per-profile overrides (dev/prod/test); feature flags and plan limits.

components.name: AsyncConfig
components.responsibility: Bounded executor for @Async work off the request path.

components.name: CacheConfig
components.responsibility: Caffeine caches with per-cache size/TTL.
